note: The page's only fonts: the browser cannot list the visitor's own, so these are written into the WebAssembly module's in-memory file system and found by the plugin's own scan (KNOCKOUT_FONT_DIR). Each is unmodified, from the google/fonts repository, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, which allows redistribution with software provided each copy carries the copyright notice and the licence: each folder's OFL.txt. demo/tools/check_shaders.py holds this list to the folder.

families.name: Anton
families.why: A heavy condensed display face, and first in the list: the plugin's own default (Arial Black, then Arial, Helvetica) is not here, so it starts on the first family.

families.name: Barlow
families.why: A plain grotesque in five of its faces (Thin, Regular, Italic, Black, Black Italic), so Weight and Italic have something to choose between.

families.name: DM Serif Display
families.copyright: Copyright 2014-2018 Adobe, with Reserved Font Name 'Source'; Copyright 2019 Google LLC
families.why: A high-contrast serif, upright and italic: hairlines next to heavy stems.

families.name: Monoton
families.copyright: Copyright (c) 2011 by Vernon Adams, with Reserved Font Name "Monoton"
families.why: An inline display face: each letter drawn as parallel lines with gaps between, sixty-odd pieces a letter where Anton has fifteen.
